tools.name: daily_signals
tools.description: Today's AI signals from Signals API: exactly 4 items, one from each core source (GitHub, Hugging Face, YouTube, Silicon Valley news), each linking to the original. Use when the user asks what's new in AI today.

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description: What changed in the AI landscape since the previous snapshot: new entries, entities no longer seen, and rank movers. Use when the user asks what's moving, rising, or different lately.

tools.name: top_models
tools.description: Hugging Face models we track, with rank, rank change and 7-day momentum. Entries without a derivable number are marked 'not ranked' with a reason instead of a guessed value.

tools.name: top_repos
tools.description: GitHub repositories we track, with rank, rank change and momentum. Use when the user asks which open-source AI projects are trending.

tools.name: archive_days
tools.description: List the archived daily editions (dates) available from the free digest. Use to find which dates can be cited.
